design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 (test_orders_and_results, category orders).

[0] Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 6]}. Assignment: reference-testing self-pay estimate = 4 factors, reference-testing cancellation fee (root) = 6. value_input floor max(1-1,1) = 1 -> the single edge is value_input.

[0] Scope snapshot. Occupied by task 0: orders_ext_recollection_window, orders_ext_genetic_self_pay_quote, orders_ext_genetic_cancellation_fee; tools request_specimen_recollection_7c5f4bb7, issue_genetic_self_pay_quote_0325000c, cancel_genetic_test_order_d90cc330 (all genetic-class or recollection). Claimed here (disjoint): orders_ext_reference_self_pay_estimate and orders_ext_reference_cancellation_fee with issue_reference_test_estimate_b0801821 and cancel_reference_test_order_ed257856, both scoped to Esoteric Reference Testing. Last task: no headroom to reserve; the union of the two scopes covers all five extended policies.

[0] Design thesis. Surface goal: 'cancel the specialized blood work from the October 1 home visit before it is run'. Scored core: handling_fee_amount. Hidden prerequisite: for an accession billed to the patient directly the fee is not fixed until a current self-pay estimate - dated within validity and no earlier than the last add-on - stands; the accession's 288.00 estimate of 2026-09-24 predates the two add-ons of 2026-10-03 (base rule: an accepted add-on on a self-pay order makes a new estimate replace the old one), so a replacement must be issued first and its amount feeds the fee's starting amount. Breadth: the estimate reads standing tests (ordered lines, add-ons, a billing-correction credit), coverage termination (coverage), an assistance case under review (assistance) and the mobile visit's fees and household (visits); the fee reads the estimate and its date against the add-on dates, days in house, test and add-on counts, payment history (invoices) and the correction credit.

[1] Policies. Both declare overwrite: the estimate supersedes the encounter-wide estimate sentence (orders_agg_requisition_encounter) and 'The amount follows the requisition-encounter rule.'; the fee supersedes the base handling-fee sentence and the confirmation sentence of orders_evt_patient_cancellation (same defect as task 0: the base gate binds an internal order id to the caller's words; the replacement keeps the patient's personal confirmation through the handed-over tool). Triggers: estimate state_due (self-pay accession whose estimate was made outdated by accepted add-ons), fee on_request.

[1] Factor card (tier taken, evidence rows, baseline figure from the sensitivity run):
- estimate.multi_test_count (parameter): four standing tests (34484 25444001-26e3-4009-a5ea-4e28bdb1bfbc; 36169 = two ordered lines less credit 7d3471a7-2842-4e76-9488-044b927d1c8a; add-ons 12e99861-b9bc-4aad-b2b8-6d8c34dce122, 2d76e43a-473d-4c53-a1d9-9ca415ce9668) -> 0.12; baseline -> 394.00. Near-miss: the 119.00 mis-posted 36169 line is credited and must not count twice.
- estimate.coverage_loss (parameter, cross coverage): no coverage on file is active (tier 1 covers never-insured and lapsed patients alike) - coverage 0246390c-933c-4fbe-87c4-1b18bc546c9c terminated 2026-08-31 -> 0.20; baseline -> 433.60.
- estimate.assistance_position (parameter, cross assistance): case 987729ad-08e2-47cb-97fc-cb2552c5dbf5 under_review and no approved award covers the date -> provisional 0.10; baseline -> 384.10. Near-miss: the case is assessed at the Full Discount tier but is not approved, so no 100% rate.
- estimate.home_collection_share (method, cross visits; its conditions read one visit row, so not counted as multi-source): Mobile In-Home visit 6105cd58-f196-4e04-b03c-5218f187ed21 with one additional household patient -> net trip fee 95.00 / 2 = 47.50 added after the reduction; baseline (no collection fee) -> 287.10. Near-miss: the 35.00 additional_patient_fee 111289b5-0cbb-4b0c-af7e-b0f4300e1847 belongs to the wife and is excluded.
- fee.starting_amount_source (method, multi-source, cross coverage): self_pay + estimate dated 2026-10-07 >= add-on date 2026-10-03 -> 0.10 x estimate; baseline (class fee 25.00) -> 27.00.
- fee.batch_stage (parameter: multiplier): accessioned, received 2026-10-02, 5 days in house -> x0.8; baseline -> 40.46.
- fee.aliquot_count (parameter): 4 standing tests -> +6.00; baseline -> 27.77.
- fee.add_on_retrieval (parameter): 2 add-ons posted (credited or not) -> +8.00; baseline -> 25.77.
- fee.payment_standing (parameter, multi-source, cross invoices): payment 06fb2d6d-c44e-4251-a218-186a23957ff5 (2025-12-20) is the only payment within 24 months, none reversed -> tier 2, -2.00; baseline -> 35.77. Near-miss: the responsibility and statement lines are not payments.
- fee.correction_apology (parameter): billing_correction credit 7d3471a7-2842-4e76-9488-044b927d1c8a -> -5.00; baseline -> 38.77.
Whole baselines: estimate 495.00, fee 25.00 (both differ from gold). Cross-difficulty factors: coverage, assistance, visits, invoices; multi-source factors: starting_amount_source, payment_standing.

[0/3] Base-invariant card. Estimate (orders_estimate_issued): orders_evt_good_faith_estimate.gfe_self_pay_only - order 749ac61f-66d2-4209-bf66-287837de6a41 billed self_pay (and no active coverage) -> satisfied; orders_agg_requisition_encounter policy_scope. Cancellation + fee line: orders_evt_patient_cancellation (gate retired by the declared overwrite; accessioned -> cancelled by user is a lifecycle transition), orders_agg_requisition_encounter and orders_order_intake (placement-only gates) -> policy_scope. No time gate applies; the estimate validity test inside the fee (estimate_date within gfe_valid_days 90 and not before the latest add-on date) is a compute input: just before - an estimate dated 2026-10-02 would fail (earlier than the 2026-10-03 add-ons); at boundary - one dated 2026-10-03 would pass. Add-on facts on record: add_on_window_days 7 after the 2026-10-01 collection (last day 2026-10-08) and max 2 add-ons - both add-ons were validly accepted.

[3] World rows. customers 24081f51-d0c9-445f-865e-c1ed036d4385; coverages 0246390c-933c-4fbe-87c4-1b18bc546c9c (terminated 2026-08-31: coverage-loss tier, gate evidence); assistance_cases 987729ad-08e2-47cb-97fc-cb2552c5dbf5 (under_review, 179.7% FPL for a household of 2); orders E 749ac61f-66d2-4209-bf66-287837de6a41 (root object) and Q d404462e-d5c8-48d3-83b7-0697af5fe1e2 (2025 order billed by the paid invoice); order_events: 34484 line, 36169 mis-posted line + billing_correction credit + re-post (estimate standing count, apology tier), two add-ons (prerequisite falsifier, aliquot and retrieval tiers), Q's A1c line; invoices + 3 invoice_transactions (one payment, no reversal); visits (mobile, zone_2, one household member) + 4 visit_events (trip and additional-patient fees assessed and paid). Deleting the add-on lines would make the 2026-09-24 estimate current and remove the prerequisite. Automatic clauses checked: the requisition (2026-09-15, 90 days) is valid through the collection; estimate 288.00 dated 2026-09-24 has not lapsed by date but is outdated by the add-ons; testing_hold_max/info_hold rules not engaged; no invoice or plan obligation is triggered. list_price_total 780.00 equals the ledger (no cache trap).

[3] Business-object card. Target accession 749ac61f-66d2-4209-bf66-287837de6a41 (requisition 1173390418), key order_id; aggregated rows: its ordered lines, add-on lines and credits; excluded: Q's line (other order); visit fees: only the collecting visit 6105cd58-f196-4e04-b03c-5218f187ed21 and only trip_fee/weekend_surcharge when shared with household members.

[2] Capability contract cards. issue_reference_test_estimate_b0801821 (agent, write): object = one reference-testing order; action = set good_faith_estimate_amount and estimate_date (today); receipt: order id, amount, date. cancel_reference_test_order_ed257856 (user, write): object = the patient's own reference-testing order; action = cancelled (patient_request, today, hold none), credit each standing test/add-on line in full (cancelled_before_testing), post one cancellation_handling_fee line at the given amount when above 0.00, update list_price_total; receipt: order id, status, date, credited count, fee, total. Neither validates the estimate or refuses.

[0/1] Problem-tree card. Root orders_ext_reference_cancellation_fee (user tool) -> orders_ext_reference_self_pay_estimate: kind value_input, gate estimate_on_file, form state, sentence 'For a reference-testing accession billed to the patient directly, the handling fee is not fixed until a reference-testing self-pay estimate dated within the class's estimate validity period, and no earlier than the last add-on test accepted on the accession, stands on it.' Four-point test: negated direction 'is not fixed until' (the contrapositive of 'fixed only after', chosen because the desk states the fee as withheld until the estimate stands; task 0 carries the affirmative direction, so the charter has both); the waited-on side is a record state (orders.good_faith_estimate_amount / estimate_date against the add-on event dates); no tool, id or code token; scope = accessions billed to the patient directly, strength 'not ... until'. Unique writer: only the reference-testing estimate policy writes an estimate on an Esoteric accession in this difficulty. Derivation: sentence + find_orders (estimate 288.00 dated 2026-09-24) + find_order_events (add-ons 2026-10-03) + the estimate policy's rule -> issue a replacement estimate. False at opening: estimate_date 2026-09-24 < 2026-10-03. Order: estimate, then cancellation. Deletion sensitivity (actual run): skip the estimate -> fee 24.00 instead of 30.77. user_scenario never mentions an estimate or price; tools validate nothing.

[4] Persona design. Marcus Bianchi, terse retired machinist; volunteers the goal (cancel the whole order before it runs), the reason (doctor says not needed) and that he is uninsured since retiring and paying himself (a fact supported by the terminated coverage and self_pay billing). Identity: phone 6172280475 + ZIP 02421 (K=2); DOB only if asked. Only-when-asked: which order (home visit October 1, heavy metals and vitamin tests, maybe something added), Bayline Choice HMO ended August 31, assistance application pending, wife drawn at the same visit for her own tests. Passive: agrees to anything done first; accepts a stated fee; runs the handed-over cancellation; stops when cancelled. No extra asks.

[5] Verification (temporary replay-and-evaluate script; output):
orders_ext_reference_self_pay_estimate step 11 result 334.6 baseline_all 495.0 (factors 394.0, 433.6, 384.1, 287.1)
orders_ext_reference_cancellation_fee step 13 result 33.77 baseline_all 25.0 (factors 27.0, 40.46, 27.77, 25.77, 35.77, 38.77) [round 2]
fee skipping estimate write: 27.0.
Replay receipts: estimate 334.60 dated 2026-10-07; order cancelled, 4 charge lines credited, fee 33.77, list-price total 33.77.
Gates (--task 1): check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_compute, check_grounding, check_cross_fire all OK; check_traceability deferred until the KB is published.

[6] Closure: estimate policy -> issue_reference_test_estimate_b0801821 -> step 11 estimate_amount 334.60 -> estimate on E; fee policy -> cancel_reference_test_order_ed257856 (user) -> step 13 handling_fee_amount 33.77 -> E cancelled with fee line. charter_scope = required_documents = [estimate, fee]. Draft recomputation from visible context (policy prose, tool schemas, finder returns, persona lines): the fee rule's 'not fixed until' sentence, the estimate date versus the add-on dates and the estimate rule give 334.60 then 30.77 with no alternative order or object - agrees with gold.

Revisions: none needed after the first run (task-0 lessons applied up front: nulls for empty foreign keys, customer-wide history read, no unreadable organization rows); a phrase in the first persona draft ('you do not ask for a price quote') was removed before gating because it hinted at the estimate.

[final] Difficulty closing record. Union of scopes: task 0 = {orders_ext_recollection_window, orders_ext_genetic_self_pay_quote, orders_ext_genetic_cancellation_fee}, task 1 = {orders_ext_reference_self_pay_estimate, orders_ext_reference_cancellation_fee}; pairwise disjoint, together equal to the five extended_policies; tools likewise disjoint and all five named by a target_tool. Each task calls one owner=user tool (the class-specific patient cancellation). Prerequisite sentences: task 0's two read in the affirmative direction ('only after'), task 1's in the negated direction ('not ... until'). Full-suite gate run (no --task): EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK (branches mean 48.00, steps mean 15.00, history_rows_max 12, branches_max 56), GROUNDING OK, CACHE-DIFF info, SCOPE OK; check_traceability awaits the published KB.
Known modeling limits recorded for the audit: (1) the orders schema gives a customer-owned write a number only through the cancellation handling fee, so the two user problems are cancellations split by service class; (2) the DSL cannot index test_menu, so each class-scoped estimate carries the class's published self_pay_price values in its params under the test number, equal to the menu; (3) the base patient-confirmation gate binds the internal order id to the caller's words, so both cancellation policies supersede that one sentence with a hand-over confirmation that keeps the patient's personal confirmation.

[round 2] Audit rework (audits/policy_task/test_orders_and_results/1.md and _difficulty.md). Symptom -> root cause -> change -> re-run:
- F-CG-1: the base clause on replacing an estimate 'on every order of the encounter' after an add-on or a lapse was handled differently but undeclared -> declared in the estimate's overwrite; the rule states the replacement is written to the reference-testing accession alone.
- F-CG-3: rule said 'the patient's only assistance case is under_review' while compute tested any case under review -> the rule now reads 'no approved award covers the estimate date and the patient has an assistance case under_review', exactly the compute.
- F-CG-4: rule counted add-ons 'standing' (not credited) while compute counted every posted add-on -> the retrieval rule now prices add-ons posted, whether or not later credited, because the specimen retrievals were already made; rule and compute agree.
- F-CG-5: batch_stage only swapped a multiplier -> relabelled parameter (the method of the fee stays starting_amount_source).
- F-CG-7: coverage_loss tier 2 ('billed self_pay') restated the scope -> ladder redesigned: no active coverage (never insured or lapsed) 0.20; active Commercial Out-of-Network Plan coverage 0.10; any other active coverage 0. This also closes O-CG-3 (the payer class is read from the active coverage) and O-CG-11. This world stays on tier 1, so the estimate is unchanged.
- O-CG-10: payment_standing gave a courtesy to a reversed payment and none to a clean single payment -> ladder now two clean payments 5.00, exactly one clean payment 2.00, otherwise 0. This world (one clean payment) moves to tier 2: the fee becomes 33.77; gold argument, computations, sensitivities, closure, solvability effect and tracing re-pointed. O-CG-5: the estimate's compute_basis for result now quotes one contiguous passage. O-CG-6: tool docstrings carry no literal ordering words. Rationale no longer calls single-row factors multi-source.
Re-run after the changes: estimate 334.60 (factors 394.00, 433.60, 384.10, 287.10; baseline 495.00), fee 33.77 (27.00, 40.46, 27.77, 25.77, 35.77, 38.77; baseline 25.00); skipping the estimate gives 27.00; full gate block green.

[round 3] Render-layer audit rework (audits/policy_kb/test_orders_and_results/1.md, audits/runtime_context/test_orders_and_results/1.md):
- P1 / E4, E5: the stand-alone combining sentences ('The starting amount is first multiplied by its batch multiplier, the aliquoting amount and the retrieval amount are then added ...', 'The multi-test rate, the coverage-loss rate and the assistance rate are first added ...', 'Collection-service fees are added after the reduction ...') and the baseline sentence 'The estimate adds no collection-service fee as a standard.' are gone. Each estimate factor now reduces the estimate by a share of 'the test price sum' (the baseline quantity) or, for the home-collection method, adds its amount to the estimate; each fee factor acts on 'the starting amount' (source, batch multiplier) or adds to / subtracts from 'the handling fee', whose baseline is the starting amount, never below zero, rounded at the end. Non-factor compute_basis entries quote baseline sentences only. The arithmetic is unchanged, so the estimate (334.60) and the fee (33.77) and every sensitivity are unchanged.
- P2: the residual clauses for the other classes are carried by the genetic policies of the charter (see task 0's round-3 entry); the Esoteric policies' own overwrites now replace the retired clauses with their class sentences only.
- Gates re-run: full block green; check_traceability reported as-is.
user_scenario:
You are Marcus Bianchi, sixty-one, a retired machinist from Lexington, Massachusetts. You speak in short, practical sentences and you like to get straight to the point. Last week a Halverson phlebotomist came to your house and drew blood for some specialized tests your doctor ordered - a heavy metals panel and a vitamin test - and drew your wife at the same visit. Since then your doctor has looked at other results and told you those tests are not needed. You call Halverson Patient Services to cancel that blood work: you want the whole order cancelled before they run it. You have no insurance at the moment because your plan ended when you retired at the end of August, so you are paying for these tests yourself. You do not know order numbers or how the laboratory prices anything.
When the agent asks who you are, you give your phone number, 6172280475, and your ZIP code, 02421. Your date of birth is 1964-11-02 and you give it only if the agent asks for it. If asked which order, it is the specialized blood work from the home visit on October 1 - the heavy metals and vitamin tests; you have heard the doctor's office may have added something to it but you are not sure what. If asked about insurance, you used to have Bayline Choice HMO and it ended August 31. If asked about financial help, you applied for Halverson's financial assistance online in late September and have not heard back yet. If asked about your wife's draw, she was drawn at the same visit for her own tests, which you are not calling about.
You let the agent take care of anything they say must be done on their side first; if they tell you something has to be updated or issued on your account before the cancellation, you say that is fine. You do not ask for anything else. If the agent tells you there is a cancellation fee, you accept it; if they give you the amount, you note it and do not dispute it. When the agent tells you that you have to confirm the cancellation yourself and hands you the cancellation step, you run it for that order with the order reference and the fee amount exactly as the agent gives them. Once you see that the order is cancelled, you thank the agent and hang up. If the agent says the order cannot be cancelled, you say okay and hang up.

edges.policy_source: For a reference-testing accession billed to the patient directly, the handling fee is not fixed until a reference-testing self-pay estimate dated within the class's estimate validity period, and no earlier than the last add-on test accepted on the accession, stands on it.
